mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.bh, c.xm, c.data_json, c.raw_json, c.owner_id, c.owner_name, c.dept_id, c.data_source, c.manual_fields, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, d.dept_name FROM biz_criminal c LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT dept_id AS deptId, parent_id AS parentId, ancestors AS ancestors, dept_name AS deptName, order_num AS orderNum, leader AS leader, phone AS phone, email AS email, status AS status, del_flag AS delFlag, create_time AS createTime FROM sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' ORDER BY order_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_criminal (bh, xm, data_json, raw_json, owner_id, owner_name, dept_id, data_source, manual_fields, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{bh}, #{xm}, #{dataJson}, #{rawJson}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{deptId}, #{dataSource}, #{manualFields}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_criminal SET del_flag = '2' WHERE id = #{id}
